meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar kai behtareen face wash available hain. Oily skin ke liye aise face wash chunne chahiye jo excess oil (sebum) ko control karein, pores ko saaf karein aur skin ko dry kiye bina clean rakhein.

500 rupees ke budget mein kuch sabse acche options ye rahe:

| Face Wash Ka Naam | Key Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Fayde |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc | ₹269 - ₹299 | Pores ko deep clean karta hai, excess oil aur blackheads/whiteheads ko kam karta hai. |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea, Glycolic Acid | ₹250 - ₹320 | Skin se extra oil remove karta hai, pimples se ladta hai aur mild exfoliation deta hai. |
| **The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide | ₹299 | Active acne ko kam karta hai aur oil production ko balance karta hai. |
| **Mamaearth Tea Tree Face Wash** | Tea Tree Oil, Neem | ₹249 - ₹299 | Antibacterial properties hoti hain jo acne aur pimples ko rokne mein madad karti hain. |
| **COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser** | Tea Tree Oil, BHA (Betaine Salicylate) | ₹285 - ₹400 | Skin ka natural barrier maintain karte hue gentle cleaning karta hai aur oil control karta hai. |

### Sahi Face Wash Kaise Chunein?

* Agar aapko **active acne (pimples) ya blackheads** ki zyada problem hai, toh **Minimalist** ya **The Derma Co.** ka **Salicylic Acid** wala face wash sabse behtar rahega.
* Agar aapko ek **natural ya herbal option** chahiye jo skin ko gentle tareeqe se clean kare, toh **Plum Green Tea** ya **Mamaearth Tea Tree** try kar sakte hain.

*Note: Inhein aap Nykaa, Amazon, ya Flipkart jaisi websites se easily 500 rupees ke andar kharid sakte hain.*
